author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: I'd appreciate it if you could check today's market overview for overall conditions first. Check my portfolio positions, then research COST - browse the stock page for current metrics and browse recent news. Email a brief market intelligence note to kenji.yamamoto@osakainvest.jp covering any material updates and their portfolio implications. Make sure to include COST's previous close price, its market cap, and its beta in the email. Report the precise values as displayed on the stock page.
